# Themes (T1): the index of what Larry holds, by subject. A theme, '=', the words that belong to
# it, separated by spaces. A conception is about the theme of its subject's head word, by this
# file or by the kinds the word is a kind of (A10: "a sparrow is a bird" puts sparrows with
# animals). A word in several themes takes the first. The index says where to search when Larry
# does not know: among the conceptions of the theme, and beyond them, the web (W1).
